name: Pillar Sky City — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Unequal sandstone/rock pillars with inhabited garden tops, small open arcade buildings and roofed pavilions, narrow suspended rope bridges and waterfalls down faces. Detailed study is a pillar settlement rather than the map's pink palace-like shorthand. Hidden layout inference: Provide one lower arrival shelf and an accessible ascent to two principal inhabited tops; bridge paths branch to smaller lookout gardens and return through a loop. Keep near/far bridges at distinct levels and preserve open vistas beneath colonnades; use existing travel anchors where physical access is unresolved. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B14-DETAIL-001 — Pillar Sky City — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need rock-to-platform footings, open arcade/corner hosts, platform edge/rail segments, rope-bridge anchor/deck details and stair-ascent joins. Do not repurpose porcelain bridge deck as rope bridge. Hanging vines and sparse canopy pockets; roosting birds/butterflies proposed. Elevation/access/collision unresolved. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
